title.zh-TW: 首次訂餐滿 $150 享 40% 折扣（最高折抵 $60）
title.en: 40% off your first order over $150 (up to $60)

text.zh-TW: 須遵守相關條款。 取自平台分享文案；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: Subject to the applicable terms. From the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟連結（會帶入優惠碼）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the link (it fills in the promo code).

steps.zh-TW: 註冊或登入 Uber Eats，確認優惠碼為 eats-v4lapf；若沒有帶入，請在結帳時手動輸入。
steps.en: Sign up or log in to Uber Eats and check that the promo code is eats-v4lapf; if it is not filled in, enter it at checkout.

steps.zh-TW: 首次訂餐消費滿 $150，結帳時套用優惠碼即可折抵。
steps.en: Place your first order of $150 or more and apply the code at checkout.

intro.zh-TW: 首次使用 Uber Eats 優食訂餐，消費滿 $150 即可享 40% 折扣（最高折抵 $60），結帳時使用優惠碼 eats-v4lapf。
intro.en: First Uber Eats order: spend $150 or more to get 40% off (up to $60) by using promo code eats-v4lapf at checkout.

description.zh-TW: Uber Eats 優食是外送訂餐平台，可在線上挑選餐點並送到指定地點。本頁的連結會開啟 Uber Eats，優惠碼 eats-v4lapf 已包含在連結中；若結帳時沒有套用，請手動輸入。首次訂餐消費滿 $150 可享 40% 折扣，最高折抵 $60，並須遵守相關條款，實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。結帳時套用優惠碼即可折抵。
description.en: Uber Eats is a food delivery platform where you pick meals online and have them delivered to an address you choose. The link on this page opens Uber Eats, and promo code eats-v4lapf is already part of the link; if it is not applied at checkout, enter it by hand. The listed offer is 40% off your first order of $150 or more, capped at $60, subject to the terms, and actual terms follow the official announcements. The discount is applied when you use the code at checkout.

notes.zh-TW: 優惠適用於首次使用 Uber Eats 優食訂餐時，消費須滿 $150，折抵上限 $60，並須遵守相關條款。優惠碼 eats-v4lapf 已包含在連結中。
notes.en: The offer applies when you order with Uber Eats for the first time: minimum spend $150, discount capped at $60, subject to the terms. Promo code eats-v4lapf is already part of the link.
